architecture.mechanism: Steam condensation location analysis reveals the presence of local vapor-free areas within the heat-sinking tube bundle under low electric load and low ambient temperature conditions, which invalidates standard radiator boundary models and creates high-error zones.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a sensor array into the condenser coil to map local heat exchange rates and identify vapor-free zones in real-time; when low-load freezing risk is detected in these zones, automatically modulate the fan speed to create localized airflow stagnation zones that maintain coil surface temperature above 0°C, or activate a precise electrical bypass load to prevent the "steam-free" drop in local heat transfer.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevents the formation of ice on the coil sections where local heat transfer fails, thereby preventing the mechanical stress that cracks the refrigerant circuit and preserves the existing refrigerant charge.
architecture.falsification_test: During a controlled shoulder-season low-load night, instrument the condenser with thermocouples at the predicted "steam-free" zones; if the intervention successfully prevents freezing, the temperature in these specific zones will remain above 0°C while the rest of the coil may be cooler, and no pressure spike indicating a blockage will occur.
